honing_confound: Full Moon Harvester's Deathlord Mode skill damage scales with Specialization (gear honing). Specialization directly increases Deathlord skill damage AND Possession Meter generation speed — dual-axis scaling identical to Shadowhunter DI. At T4, faster Deathlord Mode cycling (via FMH's Possession Meter recovery on Soul Stone use) compounds with peak Specialization for significant throughput increase.

delivery.evidence: Souleater uses three skill categories: Ghast Skills (melee-range dark slashes), Stygian Skills (area clearers, generate Possession Meter), Deathlord Skills (heavy melee attacks, primary burst tools in FMH). All melee range. Non-positional gameplay noted.

footprint.evidence: Melee-range dark blade attacks: arc and point footprints. Deathlord Skills hit in close proximity. No wide-zone bombardment identity.

geo_text: Full Moon Harvester Souleater manages two gauges: Soul Stone Meter (3 stones, filled by Basic Attacks + Ghast + Stygian skills; consumed by Deathlord Skills) and Possession Meter (filled by Soul Stone consumption + Stygian Skills). When Possession Meter reaches threshold: Deathlord Mode (Z/identity) activates — ALL Deathlord Skill cooldowns reset immediately, +20% Crit Rate, +10% Attack Speed, +20% Move Speed, enhanced damage to nearby enemies, access to Enhanced Soul Stones (3x bonus per stone). FMH IDENTITY BONUSES: Crit Rate +3/8/14%, Possession Meter recovery +5% per Soul Stone consumption → faster Deathlord Mode cycling. Deathlord Skills also get -50/60/70% cooldown during Deathlord Mode.

control.evidence: Dark blade melee skills have knockdown effects on some hits. No CC-centered identity.

defense.evidence: Mobile melee class. Non-positional reduces defensive positioning burden. Standard dodge-based defense.

economy.resource_verbatim: Soul Stone Meter (3 stones) + Possession Meter (threshold → Deathlord Mode)
economy.builder_source: Soul Stones fill via Basic Attacks + Ghast + Stygian Skills. Possession Meter fills via Soul Stone use + Stygian Skills. Deathlord Mode activates at Possession Meter threshold.
economy.plain_text: DUAL-GAUGE ECONOMY: (1) Soul Stones (3) fill via normal combat → Deathlord Skills consume stones. (2) Possession Meter fills via Soul Stone consumption + Stygian Skills → at threshold: Deathlord Mode activates. DEATHLORD MODE: ALL Deathlord cooldowns reset → burst window with enhanced Enhanced Soul Stones. FMH FEEDBACK: each Soul Stone consumption recovers +5% Possession Meter → faster Deathlord re-activation cycle. Strategy: use Stygian and Ghast to build stones and Possession → Deathlord Mode burst → maximize Deathlord skill hits during cooldown-reset window.

element.evidence: Souleater wields a large scythe and uses dark soul energy. Physical damage with Dark elemental infusion on Deathlord skills.

movement.evidence: Good mobility. Deathlord Mode: +20% Move Speed. Non-positional means no aggressive repositioning required. Mobile melee class.

attr.evidence: Melee scythe class — close range for all significant damage. Non-positional reduces the positional burden but range requirement is still melee.

range.evidence: Melee scythe: 0-5m. Some Stygian skills may extend to ~6m. No meaningful long-range capability.

tempo.evidence: Full Moon Harvester is the burst identity: build Soul Stones + Possession Meter → Deathlord Mode (cooldown reset burst window). All Deathlord Skills immediately available → concentrated damage in a short window. Then rebuild cycle.

amp.value: Deathlord Mode: +20% Crit Rate, +10% Attack Speed, +20% Move Speed, ALL Deathlord cooldowns reset, Deathlord -50/60/70% CDR during mode; FMH: +3/8/14% Crit Rate, +5% Possession recovery per Stone
amp.evidence: Maxroll FMH guide: '+10% Attack Speed, 20% Move Speed, 20% Crit Rate' and 'All Deathlord skill cooldowns reset immediately.' FMH bonus from search: 'Crit Rate +3/8/14% and Upon using Soul Stone, recover Possession Meter by 5%.' Deathlord cooldown -50/60/70% from second source.

proxy.evidence: No proxy mechanics. Soul entities are visual flavor on skills.

commitment.evidence: Deathlord Skills (primary burst tools in mode) are heavy scythe attacks with wind-up animations. During cooldown reset window, must cast each Deathlord skill in sequence — meaningful commitment per skill.

mechanics_notes: 1) COOLDOWN RESET ON DEATHLORD MODE is the core design: entering Deathlord Mode immediately resets all Deathlord Skill cooldowns. This creates a 'burst window where all your heaviest skills are simultaneously available.' Similar to Deathblade RE's -50% CDR window but more absolute (full reset vs reduction). 2) FMH POSSESSION METER FEEDBACK LOOP: +5% Possession recovery per Soul Stone consumed (during build phase) compounds over the build cycle — faster Possession accumulation → shorter time between Deathlord Mode windows. 3) NON-POSITIONAL: Souleater is noted as non-positional in guides. No back-attack or frontal requirement. This is uncommon for a melee assassin and increases accessibility. 4) S+-TIER STANDING: Full Moon Harvester is among the highest-tier DPS identities in LA as of Maxroll Aug 2025 tier list. Strong performance reflects effective Deathlord Mode burst design post-Ark Passive tuning.
stabilization_patch: Full Moon Harvester has been the dominant Souleater identity since addition; Night's Edge is the simpler secondary option.

honing_confound: Night's Edge Ghast and Deathlord skill damage scales with Crit and Swiftness (rather than Specialization). The Soul Snatch burst window amplifies Ghast skills (+120% damage, -40% CDR) — these compound with Crit gear at T4. Different stat axis than FMH (Crit/Swift vs Spec) means confound operates differently but is still present.

delivery.evidence: Night's Edge uses same three skill categories. Deathlord Mode DISABLED. Primary flow: Deathlord Skills build Edge Meter → Soul Snatch Mode empowers Ghast Skills. Two-phase rhythm: Deathlord for building → Ghast for damage windows.

footprint.evidence: Same melee-range scythe footprints as Full Moon Harvester. No wide-zone identity.

geo_text: Night's Edge Souleater replaces Possession Meter with Edge Meter (Deathlord Mode is DISABLED). Edge Meter fills via Deathlord Skills (Normal = +10% Edge from 1 Soul Stone; Enhanced = +30% Edge from 3 Soul Stones) and slowly depletes passively. At full Edge Meter: Soul Snatch Mode activates automatically — +20% Attack Speed, +10% Move Speed, +120% Damage to Ghast Skills, -40% CDR on Ghast Skills; Deathlord Skills DISABLED during Soul Snatch. When Edge Meter depletes after Soul Snatch: cycle restarts with Deathlord Skill building. NIGHT'S EDGE IDENTITY: Ghast + Deathlord skill damage +20/30/40% globally.

economy.resource_verbatim: Soul Stone Meter (3 stones) + Edge Meter (Night's Edge replacement for Possession)
economy.builder_source: Soul Stones fill via Basic Attacks + Ghast + Stygian Skills (same as FMH). Deathlord Skills consume Stones to fill Edge Meter. Edge Meter depletes passively and resets Soul Snatch.
economy.plain_text: EDGE METER CYCLE ECONOMY: (1) Soul Stones fill via combat. (2) Deathlord Skills consume stones → fill Edge Meter (1 stone = 10%; 3 stones Enhanced = 30%). (3) Edge Meter full → Soul Snatch auto-activates: +120% Ghast damage, -40% Ghast CDR, Deathlord DISABLED. (4) Edge Meter depletes over Soul Snatch → returns to Deathlord building phase. NIGHT'S EDGE GLOBAL BONUS: Ghast + Deathlord skills +20/30/40% damage at all times (not just in Soul Snatch). TWO-PHASE RHYTHM: build with Deathlord → burst with Ghast during Soul Snatch.

element.evidence: Same Physical/Dark scythe energy as FMH.

movement.evidence: Same mobile non-positional profile as FMH.

tempo.evidence: Night's Edge has a two-phase rhythm (Deathlord build → Ghast burst) but the cycle is faster and more sustained than FMH's large Deathlord Mode window. Consistent output via global +20/30/40% damage on both skill categories.

amp.value: Soul Snatch: +120% Ghast Skill damage, -40% Ghast CDR, +20% Attack Speed; Night's Edge global: Ghast + Deathlord skills +20/30/40% damage; Deathlord Skills DISABLED during Soul Snatch
amp.evidence: Maxroll Night's Edge guide: 'Soul Snatch: 20% Attack Speed, 10% Move Speed, 120% Damage to Ghast Skills, 40% Cooldown Reduction to Ghast Skills.' Night's Edge identity from search: 'Ghast Skills and Deathlord Skills gain 20/30/40% increased damage.'

commitment.evidence: Heavy Deathlord Skills (builders) have wind-up. Ghast Skills during Soul Snatch may be faster — CDR reduction speeds their use. Overall similar commitment profile to FMH.

mechanics_notes: 1) DEATHLORD MODE DISABLED is Night's Edge's defining constraint: like Perfect Suppression disabling Demonize, Night's Edge removes the primary burst transformation in exchange for a global damage bonus on BOTH skill categories. Soul Snatch replaces the mode — but it auto-triggers and empowers Ghast (not Deathlord). 2) TWO-PHASE MUTUAL EXCLUSION: Deathlord Skills disable during Soul Snatch; Deathlord Skills (implied) are what build toward Soul Snatch. This creates hard mutual exclusion — the build phase skills are the burst phase penalty. 3) EDGE METER PASSIVE DEPLETION: unlike FMH's Possession Meter which persists until threshold, Edge Meter continuously depletes over time. This creates a continuous 'spend Deathlord skills to prevent natural decay' pressure — must actively fill to maintain Soul Snatch cycles. 4) SIMPLER BUT SAME TIER CONSIDERATION: Night's Edge is S-tier (Maxroll Aug 2025) vs FMH's S+. The global +20/30/40% bonus makes Night's Edge more consistent (both phases are amplified) while FMH has the higher ceiling via cooldown-reset burst. 5) SAME PATTERN as other secondary identities: Night's Edge = remove complex transformation (Deathlord Mode) for simpler two-phase cycling with global skill amplification.
